decisive_items: a 1.5-cm long, solid structure with lobular architecture
a lobulated retroareolar mass approximately 1.5 cm in diameter without microcalcifications (BIRADS III)
a new, mildly tender, firm 1-cm subareolar mass under the left nipple
response.rationale: R5 best fits the new discrete solid lobulated retroareolar mass with no microcalcifications and a BIRADS III probably-benign pattern, consistent with fibroadenoma. R1 is a less-specific benign adenoma category, while a malignancy would be expected to show more suspicious imaging features than this vignette provides.

rejected.why: No malignant features such as microcalcifications or irregular/spiculated margins are described; BIRADS III favors a benign process.
Too nonspecific and does not account for the benign lobulated imaging pattern favoring a fibroadenoma.
Explains the prior breast swelling and history of gynecomastia, but not the new discrete solid lobulated mass.
